acceptanceCriteria.text: A packaged skill `ws-spec-to-issue` exists at `{skillsRoot}/ws-spec-to-issue/SKILL.md` with valid `name`, `description`, and an `invocation_names` entry (e.g. `/spec-to-issue`, `ws-spec-to-issue`).

The skill is registered in both `bin/skill-dependencies.json` and `.agents/skills/ws-shared/runtime/skill-dependencies.json` under the specs package with an explicit `dependencies` entry naming its provider/`ws-spec-write` callees.

The skill resolves the active tracker from `.ws/config.json` (`providers.active` `github`|`azure-devops`; else an enabled `issueTrackers.*`; else `project.repoUrl` host). Active `local` with no tracker fallback **STOPs** with a named error and never writes a local spec.
The skill runs the active provider `validate-auth` before any mutating call; auth failure **STOPs** with the provider remediation and performs no silent fallback.

The skill builds a spec-shaped payload (title + body carrying Description, atomic testable Acceptance Criteria, and Out of Scope) by **agentic reformulation** of the free-text description, reusing the `ws-spec-write` reformulation protocol — not a verbatim copy of the input.

The payload is anonymized before creation: no private consumer project names, no absolute local paths, no hostnames, no secrets, and no customer data; the description states the failure class or feature generically when the input quoted private context.

The skill creates the item via the active provider `create-issue` intent (GitHub `create_issue.cjs`; ADO `create_issue.cjs --type "User Story"`), passing the body through `--body-file` to avoid inline-quoting hazards, and prints the created id and URL.
A successful run leaves **no** local artifact: no `{specsDir}` spec of record, no `{plansDir}` folder, no `git add`/commit; `git status --porcelain` is byte-identical before and after the run.
`--dry-run` prints the resolved tracker, title, and body and creates nothing; it exits 0.

The skill never embeds tokens; the token is read only from the configured env var by the provider script, any temp body file is created outside the tracked tree and removed after the call, and nothing sensitive is echoed.
A creation failure (auth, network, validation, or provider non-zero exit) is reported with the provider error and a non-zero exit; no partial or half-written local artifact remains.

The created item round-trips: running `ws-spec-from-provider` (or provider `fetch-to-spec`) on the new id produces a valid spec of record that passes `validate_spec.cjs --mode=authoring` (or `--mode=compat` when the body lacks closure tables).

The new skill is routed/indexed in `AGENTS.md`, `.ws/AGENTS.md`, `README.md`, `FEATURES.md`, `CATALOG.md`, `autoload.md`, `docs/llms.txt`, and the generated site; `ws-check-harness` Phases 0–5c report 0 findings and `test/test-harness-clean.js` reports 0 findings.
`npm run generate-integrity` + `npm run verify-integrity` exit 0 and `package.json` `version` / `packageVersion` are bumped once for the release PR.

negativeScenarios.text: `providers.active: local` with no enabled tracker: the skill STOPs with a named error and writes no file; a test asserts no `{specsDir}` or `{plansDir}` output.
Auth missing/invalid for the resolved tracker: the create step fails with the provider remediation and a non-zero exit; no item is created and no local artifact remains.
Input containing a private project name, absolute path, or hostname: the built payload must not contain it; a test asserts the anonymizer strips it before the create call.
Provider `create_issue.cjs` returns non-zero (network/validation): the skill reports the error, exits non-zero, and leaves `git status --porcelain` unchanged.
`--dry-run` accidentally performing a create: the payload print is the only output and no provider mutation occurs (negative assertion on the provider dry-run path).
Running the skill inside an active workflow: no `git add`/commit/stash/reset is issued and the tree stays clean.
